jiffy.text: I'll be ready in a jiffy.
I'll be back in a jiffy.
It'll be ready in a jiffy.
We'll get you home in a jiffy.
He fixed the problem in a jiffy.

tr.ru: Он решил проблему в считаные минуты.

jigsaw.text: Tom is assembling a jigsaw puzzle.
I bought a new jigsaw puzzle.

tr.de: Ich habe ein neues Puzzle gekauft.

jigsaw.text: Tom put together a jigsaw puzzle.
Tom and Mary are assembling a jigsaw puzzle.
I felt it was a relatively difficult jigsaw puzzle.

tr.de: Ich empfand es als ein relativ schwieriges Puzzle.

jig.text: Tom burst out laughing when he saw Mary dancing a jig.

tr.de: Tom brach in Lachen aus, als er Maria Jig tanzen sah.

jingling.text: I heard the jingling of keys.

jiggled.text: Tom's huge belly jiggled like jelly.

tr.ru: Огромный живот Тома колыхался, как желе.
